description: Native 2.1.0 rc2 material/phase output-head probe: initialize from native 1.5.0, add two dense output-head features, train only the output layer on existing native 1.5 labeled data with calibrated LR 0.1, and validate with the material-head-capable Enyo candidate.

validation.promotion_gate: First gate is engine-static plus move-choice failure replay. If those are neutral-positive, run a 256-game Crucible-distributed smoke versus native-1.5.0 before any 1000+ game confirm.
validation.reason: The zero-expanded material/phase head is eval-identical to native-1.5.0 and measured at 0.9965x legacy NPS in candidate-engine fixed-depth preflight. rc1 used lr=3e-6 and was effectively a no-op; a short output-only LR calibration found lr=0.1 produced the best held-out static signal. This probe tests whether two cheap dense output features can correct phase/material scaling without changing the feature layout or regenerating data.
